name: Arcane Symphony
description: Fuels the destructive power of your group members, allowing them to strike with Arcane Symphony Effect III, which deals 16844 damage when they cast a damaging spell up to level 115, or a chance to strike with Arcane Symphony Strike III, which deals 15496 damage, when making melee attacks. Lasts for 12 seconds or until you have enhanced 4 spells.
